patches.before: Japanese also uses [[jp:インバウンド]] for foreign visitors to Japan, and in both cases it points from outside toward the company.
patches.after: Japanese also uses [[jp:インバウンド]] for foreign visitors to Japan; in both cases it means coming in from outside, and here it means customers coming to the company.
